component.name: Anchor
component.summary: Block distracting apps on your Android phone

description.p: Anchor is an app blocker for Android that helps you spend less time on your phone and is impossible to bypass from the phone itself. You pick the apps that distract you on your computer, and with one click they disappear from your phone. Only this computer can bring them back, over a USB cable.

ul.li: Hide any app in one click, without deleting its data
Schedules, such as YouTube hidden every night
A Never allow list that stops apps from being installed at all
No accounts, no tracking: everything stays on your devices

description.p: Free version: one phone per computer.
